sources.title: LoRa modulation FAQ

related.title: LoRaWAN 空中時間：區域限制與報告配額
related.titleEn: LoRaWAN airtime: regional limits and report budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 1.024 ms/symbol 與 8.192 ms/symbol，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 1.024 ms/symbol and 8.192 ms/symbol, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋180 reports/hour與45 reports/hour，建立lorawan_airtime.csv、區域版本欄、含重試排程，並完成以下驗收：每分鐘1報共60報需求只在0.2 s例可行；真實部署須依當地核准參數重算。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 180 reports/hour and 45 reports/hour; create lorawan_airtime.csv, regional-version field and retry-inclusive schedule; apply this acceptance decision: Sixty hourly reports fit only the0.2 s case; real deployments require recalculation with locally authorized parameters.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 LoRa符元時間Ts=2^SF/BW；SF增大使符元變長，原始bit速率與實際封包率仍需編碼及標頭。 展開基準式 2**7/125000*1000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：兩者比值應為2^(10-7)=8；以符元頻率倒數重算時間。 將兩條推導一起存入 lora_symbols.csv、SF/BW一致性表、符元比值。

從原理 給定空中時間預算時，報告數上限為floor(可用時間/每包時間)；區域法規與通道群必須另核實。 展開基準式 floor(3600*0.01/0.2)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：建立3600 s排程、逐筆累加空中時間；重傳與join也占預算，不能只算成功應用報告。 將兩條推導一起存入 lorawan_airtime.csv、區域版本欄、含重試排程。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from LoRa symbol durationTs=2^SF/BW grows with SF; raw bit rate and packet rate also require coding and headers., expand baseline expression 2**7/125000*1000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: The ratio must be2^(10-7)=8; cross-check by inverting symbol frequency. Save both derivations with lora_symbols.csv, SF/BW agreement and symbol-ratio checks.

Starting from With a stated airtime budget, packet count isfloor(available time/airtime per packet); regional rules and subband aggregation require separate verification., expand baseline expression floor(3600*0.01/0.2); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Build a3600 s schedule and sum airtime; retries and joins consume budget as well as successful reports. Save both derivations with lorawan_airtime.csv, regional-version field and retry-inclusive schedule.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GPS 授時：奈秒偏移如何變成距離誤差
related.titleEn: GPS timing: converting nanoseconds to range error
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 1.024 ms/symbol 與 8.192 ms/symbol，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 1.024 ms/symbol and 8.192 ms/symbol, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋2.99792458 m pseudorange bias與29.9792458 m pseudorange bias，建立gps_clock.csv、共同時鐘欄、偽距殘差，並完成以下驗收：5 m單項距離預算僅10 ns例通過；不等於整體GPS定位誤差小於5 m。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 2.99792458 m pseudorange bias and 29.9792458 m pseudorange bias; create gps_clock.csv, common-clock column and pseudorange residuals; apply this acceptance decision: Only10 ns meets a5 m single-term budget; that does not establish total GPS position error below5 m.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 LoRa符元時間Ts=2^SF/BW；SF增大使符元變長，原始bit速率與實際封包率仍需編碼及標頭。 展開基準式 2**7/125000*1000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：兩者比值應為2^(10-7)=8；以符元頻率倒數重算時間。 將兩條推導一起存入 lora_symbols.csv、SF/BW一致性表、符元比值。
從原理 未校正時間偏差dt產生偽距偏差c*dt；同一接收器時鐘偏差是共同未知量，不能各衛星任意刪除。 展開基準式 299792458*10/1000000000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：由距離除c還原10/100 ns；四衛星解算需共同位置三維加時鐘四未知量。 將兩條推導一起存入 gps_clock.csv、共同時鐘欄、偽距殘差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from LoRa symbol durationTs=2^SF/BW grows with SF; raw bit rate and packet rate also require coding and headers., expand baseline expression 2**7/125000*1000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: The ratio must be2^(10-7)=8; cross-check by inverting symbol frequency. Save both derivations with lora_symbols.csv, SF/BW agreement and symbol-ratio checks.

Starting from Uncorrected timing biasdt creates pseudorange biasc*dt; a receiver clock bias is a shared unknown rather than an arbitrary per-satellite subtraction., expand baseline expression 299792458*10/1000000000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Divide range bias byc to recover10/100 ns; four-satellite positioning includes three position unknowns plus one clock term. Save both derivations with gps_clock.csv, common-clock column and pseudorange residuals.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
